detail.longDescription: By the way, dear # GitLab : I can see from my browser dev tools that my browser is indeed sending your GraphQL endpoint an awful lot of requests, and I'm sure that's why you're throwing 429s…but maybe you should've thought about that BEFORE you wrote your front-end code this way. You know how many database-hitting requests get sent to my work's # Forgejo when I load up an issue in its issue tracker? Two! And one of them is optional! So, as the kids are wont to say: skill issue. # programming
